searchText: Sorry I'm a bit late to this conversation. Peer sampling is an optional feature in the spec, and I was hoping we *could* implement it to reduce bandwidth usage. It could be used to enable higher blob counts in future BPO forks before Glamsterdam. Is this no longer what we want? Nope, this make sense and likely don't require changes for most clients i believe? at least for Lighthouse Please note if you see ``` Evaluation error: Cannot construct 'ServiceConfig' from the provided arguments. Caused by: ServiceConfig: unexpected keyword argument "tty_enabled" ``` You need to update your kurtosis engine to version 1.9+. Run `kurtosis version` to fetch your current version. If your current kurtosis is version is reported to be `2.1.0` then you are on a borked kurtosis release. Please reinstall kurtosis, and it should get you back on track. Fusaka-devnet-2 genesis at <t:1750932000:R> ```yaml FULU_FORK_EPOCH: 256 BLOB_SCHEDULE: - EPOCH: 512 MAX_BLOBS_PER_BLOCK: 12 - EPOCH: 768 MAX_BLOBS_PER_BLOCK: 15 - EPOCH: 1024 MAX_BLOBS_PER_BLOCK: 18 - EPOCH: 1280 MAX_BLOBS_PER_BLOCK: 9 - EPOCH: 1584 MAX_BLOBS_PER_BLOCK: 20 ``` It would be really good to have all CL devs take a look at their cgc/eth2/nfd values BEFORE fulu, and make 100% sure that you got all the fields correct. I have set FULU 1d from now, so every client will have sufficient time to take a look and push out final fixes. 1/2 of nodes are supernodes 1/2 of nodes are full nodes Every node has 8 validators Every node's cgc should be 0x08 BEFORE fulu. Everyone's eth2 value should match everyone else's eth2 value Everyone's nfd value should match everyone else's nfd value I have included every client combo in the fusaka-devnet-2. Having fulu a day from now should give enough time to everyone to be able to make a fulu ready fusaka-devnet-2 branch. we should make sure that those supernodes host has more capacity than fullnode, particularly storage cgc should 0x08 for fullnode, 0x80 for supernode, right? Tooling is online: https://fusaka-devnet-2.ethpandaops.io Pre fulu: grandine: eth2: `0x8100131a709375440001000000000000` nfd: `0x369f89f7` cgc: ✅ lighthouse: eth2: `0x8100131a709375440001000000000000` nfd: `0x369f89f7` cgc: ✅ lodestar: eth2: `0x8100131a709375440001000000000000` nfd: `0x369f89f7` cgc: ✅ ~~<@&595681771690000403> - reporting 0x04 instead of 0x08 on full node~~ after 350 slots its been updated nimbus: eth2: `0x8100131a709375440001000000000000` nfd: `0x369f89f7 ` ✅ cgc: ✅ prysm: eth2: ~~`0x8100131a709375440000000000000000`~~ `0x8100131a709375440001000000000000` ✅ fixed nfd: `0x369f89f7` cgc: ✅ teku: eth2: `0x8100131a709375440001000000000000` nfd: `0x369f89f7` cgc: ✅ ~~- reporting 0x04 instead of 0x08 on full node - <@&836981489430036500> - ~~ after 350 slots its been updated We need all these values fixed ideally in the next few hours. Please if you see your name tagged, get on this. > nimbus: > eth2: 0x8100131a709375440001000000000000 > nfd: ❌ - not reporting nfd <@&595681804422479873> > cgc: ❌ - reporting 0x04 instead of 0x08 on full nodes unstable branch does that giving you devnet branch in some time We have finalized with 100% attestation pre fulu. Started fuzzing / spamming now. As soon as spamming begun, nimbusel stopped including tx/blobtx in the blocks. <@706747269424218124> Maybe I should increase the blob pool size <@491624610215886849> we can take this discussion in another separate thread https://discord.com/channels/595666850260713488/1385180952145170493/1387738563700981780 I plan to delete `berlinterop-devnet-2` by EOD. Please let me know if you opposing this. prysm fix pushed to our branch and ethpandaops image built https://discord.com/channels/595666850260713488/1385180952145170493/1387764303326871665 LGTM Thank you! I'm planning to roll out watchtower on fusaka-devnet-2. This will enable us to automatically deploy new fusaka images. Watchtower will check every 2 mins if there is a new fusaka image avaialble (using the same tag) and yolo roll it out. Please be aware of this, as we are also automatically build fusaka-devnet-2 branches now, so if you push something yolo into that branch it might take all clients of your pair offline. Thanks for coming to my ted talk. Just to confirm, devnet-2 launched with 7907 active? I see that the 11k+ accounts with "big code" have not been deployed, so I guess we have to do this manually to bench test the new code size reads (and which will also flag clients which do not have a quick codeSize lookup). I'm converting the perfnet benches to EEST and spamoor so we can deploy these benches in the future also 🙂 Similar thing for hive tests might be useful, with an exception of the main branch as it may trigger too often Do all clients have a codeHash => codeSize cache in some form implemented? (either in memory or as extra db) This is unfortunate, because the disk lookup attack will need 11k+ contracts. For it to be the most effective we have to deploy the max size contracts (so limited by the 30M gas limit per tx). This however means we can only deploy 1 contract per block. So we need 11k+ blocks to setup the disk attack 😦 I actually want to do this "attack" because it will most likely throw out all clients which do not have the codeHash => codeSize cache it’s active as of tomorrow epoch 256 30M gas limit will only be live from tomorrow, so today you can still do 45M txs Ah ok 🙂 I see, but I want to deposit big contracts > 24 KiB. So have to wait for the fork for that 🙂
